crossRefs.note: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves…
When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.
When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after…
Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek to Yahweh. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
translations.bsb: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites had gathered at Mizpah, their rulers marched up toward Israel. And when the Israelites learned of this, they feared the Philistines
translations.kjv: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpeh, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
translations.asv: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
